proposition: In letter 35 Ibn Turka, travelling from Lahijan during the first ten days of Jumādā II (ca. 831-32/1428-29), wrote to the shaykh al-islām of Tabriz, Sayyid Muḥammad b. Shaykh Kajujī, and sent greetings to his khanaqah, saying he longed to be with them.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka, writing to Sayyid Muḥammad b. Shaykh Kajujī
mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)
mediation.note: Dating and route ('Lahijan-Tabriz?') are MK's conjecture
